config.lodgen.title: Voxy LOD Gen
config.lodgen.where: These settings apply to worlds you play or host. On a dedicated server, the server's config/lodgen.json counts. A running world uses them as soon as you save.
config.lodgen.radius.tooltip: How far LODs reach, in chunks
config.lodgen.featureRadius.tooltip: Up to this distance (in chunks) LODs get trees, plants and structures. Further away only terrain, which is faster
config.lodgen.terrainFirst.tooltip: First terrain quickly up to the full radius, then trees, plants and structures follow, closest first. Off: each distance is finished with its details before the next one
config.lodgen.structures.tooltip: Villages, towers, ruins... in the LODs within the detail radius, also from structure mods
config.lodgen.sendSavedChunks.tooltip: Chunks that already exist (explored, with everyone's builds) become LODs too, read from the save, and are sent again when they change. Replaces Voxy Server Side for this
config.lodgen.keepUnderground.tooltip: Also send what lies deep underground where no daylight reaches. Only visible from inside caves, about doubles the data
config.lodgen.viewDistanceMargin.tooltip: Chunks this close beyond the view distance are left to the game
config.lodgen.threads.tooltip: Worker threads while playing. More is faster but leaves less CPU time for the game
config.lodgen.threadsWhilePaused.tooltip: Worker threads while the single player game is paused: it needs no CPU time then
config.lodgen.tileSize.tooltip: Chunks with details are generated in tiles of this many chunks per side. Larger tiles waste less work at their edges but take more memory
config.lodgen.sendToPlayers.tooltip: Players who join your world and also have this mod and Voxy get LODs over the network
config.lodgen.farPlayers.tooltip: Players beyond the view distance are shown on the LODs, with what they ride, to everyone who gets LODs
config.lodgen.maxChunksPerSecondPerPlaye: Network limit for each player, about 20 KiB per chunk before compression
lodgen.map.title: 3D Map
lodgen.map.unsupported.title: No map here
lodgen.map.unsupported.nether: Voxy could not be cut open here, the roof would hide everything.
lodgen.map.settings.title: Map settings
config.lodgen.mapRadius.tooltip: While a player has the 3D map open, the terrain where it looks is generated first, up to this far from them (in chunks), also beyond the reach. 0 turns this off
config.lodgen.checkForUpdates.tooltip: Asks GitHub at each start whether there is a newer version for this Minecraft version and tells you in chat
config.lodgen.autoUpdate.tooltip: Downloads a newer version by itself, checks its SHA-256 checksum and swaps it in when the game quits. Takes effect from the next start
lodgen.update.downloaded: Voxy LOD Gen %s has been downloaded (installed: %s) and is installed when the game quits.
config.lodgen.updateMessageDelay.tooltip: This many seconds after joining a world the message about a new or downloaded version shows, so it comes after the messages of joining
lodgen.voxyMissing.title: Voxy is missing
lodgen.voxyMissing.message: Voxy LOD Gen makes the LODs for Voxy, but Voxy is not installed. Without Voxy the mod shows nothing and there is no 3D map.
